Title: couple of questions that popped up last night

Messages.Author: John Woods
Messages.Body:
1) A minion has Pier 13 Baltimore equipped and is sent to torpor. Can
that minion equip during the influence phase? Pier 13 says that the
equipping is not an action (so that precludes the rule about minions
not taking actions in torpor). Since we figured that the effect "just
happens" since there is nothing on the card stating which state the
vampire needs to be in (ready, controlled, etc), we let the minion
equip.

2) Vamps A and B are in combat and there's a Trap in play. Vamp A has
a Crimson Sentinel and hits Vamp B, sending B into torpor. But B play
an Undead Persistence. Combat continues for 3 more rounds, with A
hitting B each round with the Crimson Sentinel. Does the Sentinel
gain a counter each time it hits Vamp B even though Vamp B isn't
losing blood (it has none to lose)? The Sentinel is still doing
damage, but the opposing vamp just doesn't have any blood to lose.
I'm not sure what would happen here.

Thanks,
John

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Woods wrote:
> 1) A minion has Pier 13 Baltimore equipped and is sent to torpor. Can
> that minion equip during the influence phase?

Yes.

> 2) Vamps A and B are in combat and there's a Trap in play. Vamp A has
> a Crimson Sentinel and hits Vamp B, sending B into torpor. But B play
> an Undead Persistence. Combat continues for 3 more rounds, with A
> hitting B each round with the Crimson Sentinel. Does the Sentinel
> gain a counter each time it hits Vamp B even though Vamp B isn't
> losing blood (it has none to lose)? The Sentinel is still doing
> damage, but the opposing vamp just doesn't have any blood to lose.
> I'm not sure what would happen here.

Yes. The Sentinel's card text doesn't mention blood loss at all; it
is only concerned about damage being successfully inflicted.
